topicName: What is method overloading and method overriding?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is method overloading and method overriding?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Method overloading and overriding are key concepts in object-oriented programming (OOP), specifically related to polymorphism. Overloading allows a class to have multiple methods with the same name but different parameters. Overriding allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a method that is already defined in its superclass."}]
